message.text:
The scheduler package exists. I need to verify whether it is wired into the server with a database cleanup job.

Searching server/cmd for scheduler.New, Register, and database cleanup references.

The scheduler package is only used internally within `internal/scheduler` and is never imported elsewhere.

No nightly database-cleanup job is registered in production code. The "0 2 * * *" schedule appears only in documentation examples, not in the wired server startup.

r03.

**Premise correction:** This repository has no nightly database-cleanup job registered in a cron scheduler at runtime, so no scheduled run time applies.

There is a generic cron scheduler library in `internal/scheduler/` (`internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `internal/scheduler/job.go`), but nothing outside that package imports or starts it — no `scheduler.New`, `Register`, or `Start` in `cmd/`, `server/`, or `store/`. A repo-wide search finds no production “database cleanup” cron job.

The only “nightly cleanup” references are examples/docs, e.g. `Schedule: "0 2 * * *"` (2:00 AM) in ```14:16:internal/scheduler/doc.go``` and ```97:100:internal/scheduler/example_test.go``` — illustrative only, not wired into the app.

Background work that does run includes the S3 presign runner (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`, every 12 hours) and in-memory cache cleanup (`store/cache/cache.go`, every 5 minutes). Neither is a nightly database-cleanup cron job.
